items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL bead aspirate/dispense into every sample well followed by 10 aspirate/dispense mix cycles of 70 uL; the Step 2 5 min incubation comment precedes the magnet comment.
Step 3 magnet/wait comment recorded; log shows 90 uL from each sample well to waste A1, then two 200 uL ethanol adds each followed by 200 uL removal from every well to waste.
Comments for 5 min dry, magnet disengage, 2 min incubation and re-engage are present; log shows 50 uL water added per well with 10 mix cycles.
Log lines 6530-6911 show 45 uL aspirated from each sample well and dispensed into the same-named elution_plate well (A1->A1 ... H12->H12).
Every well operation (beads, supernatant, ethanol add/removal, water, elution) is bracketed by pick up tip/drop tip per well in the log, so no cross-contamination.

judge.summary: The protocol performs all 13 steps with correct volumes, well pairings and mix counts, recording the non-pipetting steps as comments. A fresh tip is used for every well in every step, and all rubric items pass.
